qa.q: Besides cooking, are there any other skills that people need to learn if they live on their own?

qa.q: Is it good for young people to live by themselves?
qa.a: Eventually, yes, though when that is probably comes down to the individual circumstances it's important to be reasonably independent and make your own choices for your own mental health if nothing else.
